regions.today: A mild evening with a little rain.
regions.tonight: Any lingering rain will clear early tonight with cloud breaking. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start mostly dry. Rain will develop in the afternoon. The rain will clear in the west of Leinster during the evening as fresh and gusty southwest winds change westerly. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees.
